offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures bearings and industrial power transmission products, sold to original equipment makers and aftermarket distributors in vehicles, rail, aerospace, energy and industrial machinery. Products are made in its own plants and sold directly and through distributors.

primary_products.value: tapered roller bearings; mounted bearing units; industrial power transmission components; couplings; industrial chain

primary_services.value: bearing repair and reconditioning; condition monitoring; engineering and application support

customer_segment.value: B2B: vehicle and equipment manufacturers, rail operators, aerospace firms, industrial machinery builders, aftermarket distributors

end_markets.value: automotive; heavy truck; rail; aerospace; energy; industrial machinery; agriculture; construction

revenue_model.value: product sales: bearings and power transmission products sold to manufacturers and distributors; service fees: repair, reconditioning and engineering support for installed bearings

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: makes bearings and drive components from steel, sold to equipment makers and distributors

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, South America, Asia and other regions with manufacturing and sales sites

specialization.value: related lines: bearings, mounted bearing units, power transmission components, couplings and industrial chain

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales engineers selling to original equipment manufacturers and large industrial accounts; distributors / dealers: independent bearing and power transmission distributors serving aftermarket customers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: environmental, workplace safety, product quality and export control rules for manufacturing and trade
